2) Retention: Our legal wants a 7-year audit trail for access logs, but we may be able to accept summarized logs for older records — will confirm.

- encryption at rest & in transit (KMS options)

Hi Samantha —

Quick technical notes to address your questions; happy to expand in the workshop. High-level: we support strict PHI controls and multiple hosting options (hosted with private tenancy, Dedicated pools, or Private VPC/onsite) so you can choose the deployment that matches your compliance needs.

Encryption / KMS:
- Encryption in transit: TLS 1.2+ for all API traffic.
- Encryption at rest: AES-256. Customers can bring their own KMS key (BYOK) for key rotation and separation of duties.

Logging / inference data:
- By default our hosted product logs request metadata (timestamps, model, token counts) and stores a redacted form of prompts/responses. Redaction rules can be configured; for PHI customers we offer a no-persist mode (no logs of prompt/completion text) or a redaction pipeline before storage.
- Full-text logs are only retained if explicitly enabled by customer; they are encrypted and access-controlled.

Deletion / purge SLA:
- We have an API for data purge. Standard SLA for hosted customers: data purge initiated within 48 hours and completion within 7 days (dependent on caching/batch processing). For Dedicated/Private we provide a deterministic purge process and can contract a shorter SLA.

Audit trails / retention:
- Access logs (who queried what) can be retained natively for 365 days in hosted; we can export and ship to your SIEM for longer retention. For customers requiring 7+ years retention, recommended approach is periodic exports to your archival storage (we can automate exports as part of the MAP).

Attachments: SOC2_Type2_Redacted_2025.pdf (attached in follow-up email from Dev)

If useful, Dev and I can join the legal/security call.

Regards,
Vivek

Samantha / team —

Attaching the redacted SOC 2 Type II report and a short CSV with our proposed retention tiers. A few clarifications and commitments we can include in the MAP: 

- SOC 2: provide redacted report now; full bridge letter and auditor contact upon NDAs/contract signature.
- KMS: support for AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, and HSM for Private deployments.
- Logging: default retention 365 days; can push to customer S3/GCS for long-term archival.
- PHI: for PHI workloads we recommend Dedicated or Private deployment and enabling "no-persist" mode for inference text unless explicit consent/logging is required.
- Audit trail export: we can add an automation to push access logs to your archival bucket monthly (we will include this in the MAP).
- Deletion SLA: contractually guarantee purge completion within 72 hours for hosted customers with a 7-day exception window for distributed caches; can be tightened for Dedicated/Private.

I attached: SOC2_Type2_Redacted_2025.pdf, Data_Retention_Table.csv

If you confirm the retention/PHI constraints we will update the MAP (Data & Compliance tab) and add explicit milestones: 
- Security review sign-off (owner: Dan Li) — target 2026-03-26
- Legal contract review & redlines (owner: Samantha / Acme Legal) — target 2026-03-29
- Deployment decision (Hosted no-persist / Dedicated / Private) — owner: Acme Infra — target 2026-03-30

Let us know if the timeline looks reasonable and whether you want us to schedule the security workshop.

Best,

Dev / Vivek —

Thanks for the clarifications and the SOC2 excerpt. A few follow-ups from security: 

- We need a written confirmation of BYOK behavior (who can rotate/revoke keys) and a documented key rotation policy. Please include this in the MAP as an explicit deliverable.
- For audit logs, Acme requires immutability guarantees for exported logs (append-only in our archive) and proof of export. Can Redwood provide signed export manifests monthly?
- Deletion SLA: the 72-hour contractual purge is acceptable if you can ensure certificate of deletion and an audit trail for the purge event. Please include the purge proof as a deliverable.

If you can incorporate these as discrete MAP milestones (owner + artifact + target date), we can proceed with legal review. 

Proposed MAP adjustments: 
- BYOK policy doc (owner: Redwood Security / Dev) — due 2026-03-24
- Signed export manifest automation (owner: Redwood Infra / Vivek) — due 2026-03-29
- Purge certificate artifact (owner: Redwood Support / Logan) — due 2026-03-30

Samantha — once those are in the MAP we'll have Legal start their review.

Thanks,
